system:
You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

{
  "headline": "The dal-OUTCOMES trial of dalcetrapib in 15,871 patients with recent acute coronary syndrome was stopped early for futility after an independent DSMB found no clinically meaningful efficacy, consistent with the calculator's prediction of low probability of success (7.2%) due to HDL-C being a non-causal biomarker for cardiovascular disease.",
  "summary": "The phase III dal-OUTCOMES trial randomized 15,871 patients with stable coronary heart disease and recent acute coronary syndrome to dalcetrapib 600 mg daily or placebo, with a planned 1,600 primary endpoint events and median follow-up of 2.5 years. The trial was stopped early for futility after the independent data monitoring committee concluded that dalcetrapib did not provide benefit, and Roche subsequently terminated the entire dal-HEART programme. No safety signal was identified. The calculator predicted a 7.2% probability of success based on an expected hazard ratio of 0.975 (2.5% relative risk reduction) derived from a modest LDL-C reduction of -5% observed in phase 2, categorizing the programme as biomarker_not_causal because the intended biomarker (HDL-C elevation via CETP inhibition) lacks causal genetic support (CETP genetic association score 0.736 with zero evidence before trial launch).
